title: The 1,024-slot frame
about: A function whose objects all stay live: its frame is n + 3 slots, measured, against the native frame limit and a g.limit check.
tries: Why can stackReuse not share the slots of o11 to o18?
At what n would wide exceed the 1,024-slot limit, and how do you know?
How does the arena strategy change what is limited?
